title: AES-256-GCM gzip envelope
description: canonical(envelope) must be at most 950000 ASCII bytes. AES-GCM uses a 128-bit tag appended to ciphertext. AAD is canonical({format:3,scope,encoding:'gzip',plainBytes}). Decode only after validating lengths and canonical unpadded base64url (including zero padding bits). Inflate incrementally, abort above plainBytes, and require exactly plainBytes ASCII bytes and canonical JSON. The whole snapshot, including manifest, is limited to 33554432 plaintext bytes.
